methodology.views: Real GLB/WorldView/CellStreamer/Havok with fixed camera relocation, no simulated walking or network input. Preview/adapter entry and exit are separate from the full-client run.
methodology.routes: Ring, opposite corners (-260,-735) and (325,125), each followed by 5500ms real wait, then ring; repeat twice. Compare scene/physics/resource signatures at each identical point.
methodology.images: Decode 8-bit PNG rows, inverse PNG filters, compare RGB channels per pixel. Exact byte-equal PNGs for five views. Small edge differences in ring/theatre supplement, not replace, world-geometry tests.
methodology.warmEntry: Adapter enter after complete preview preparation. Not comparable with fresh-context game entry.
methodology.coldEntry: Fresh browser context and temporary database schema. Measure click on enabled join through playing/criticalReady. Preview prefetch before click is part of both identical scenarios; not a total navigation or compressed-transfer measurement.
methodology.collisionMemory: Actual parsed collision heap and native/GPU byte sizes unavailable. Serialized collision input proxy sums each retained cell asset dependency with multiplicity because loadCellPhysics parses per cell; this is not JS heap usage.
methodology.frameTiming: Short software-rendered shared workstation measurements. Both maps measured sequentially with identical renderer, viewport, quality and camera; does not establish hardware frame budget.

resources.byteDefinition: Decoded HTTP resource bodies, including retries; not compressed transfer or WebSocket bytes.

fullGameAfter.database: Local temporary PostgreSQL on 127.0.0.1:55439; unique schema through createDatabaseFixture, dropped by close; no working database touched

limitations: Software rasterization, no target GPU or isolated 2vCPU server hardware acceptance.
Two-second frame samples are comparative diagnostics, not long-run percentiles.
Peak pending queue is not instrumented in this browser run; capture values and real HTTP peak are recorded, plus independent content/queue tests.
Actual parsed JS collision heap, GPU/native bytes and hardware server-step percentiles were not measured.
Harness route uses configured camera/area relocation; walking, input and reconnect behavior have separate production/unit checks.
Transport reconnect was checked through page reload with preserved player identity; forced offline/online reconnection was not repeated in this city probe.
